claim_one_line: DISCHARGING THE TRIPLET & INDEX POSTULATES (SPACETIME & GAUGE EMERGENCE): The wordings weave <L_ab, L_ba, R_ab, R_ba> generates the full mapping class group Aut+(F2) =~ Mod(M1,2) and acts on V = T (+) T_bar via G96 (order 96), leaving no proper sub-domains in the 6D puncture module L6 invariant, uniquely forcing |ind_4D| = 3. On M1,2, a 4D Dolbeault-Dirac operator coupled to K^(1/2) (x) W_Lambda+(nD_inf) has index exactly +-3n with Leray E2 degeneration, turning the modular count into a physical 4D index. Under (E6 x SU(3)T)/Z3 in E8, V sits in the fundamental 6 of SU(6) and L6 sits in (6, 3_T); the center (-I6, -I2, +I3) = 1_E8 protects all three SU(2)w weak roots intact, and boundary polarization yields the exact Standard Model gauge group SU(3)c x SU(2)w x U(1)Y with all 5 rational hypercharges. Finally, non-Sturmian weave moves activate T -> T_bar couplings, and wave interference breaks flavour degeneracy, producing three distinct generational eigenvalues.
